observations: body: the figure stands at the left of lines 12 to 28, which are set beside it in a narrower measure; the line numbers 5 to 40 stand in the right margin and the locators «p. 96.» (L12) and «p. 97.» (L33) in the left margin, «p. 96.» left of the figure.

body: the figure is redrawn from measurements of the print: its five circles and its seven straight lines are least-squares fits to the printed ink, and its twenty-one letters (bold italic capitals) stand where they are printed. In the print the circle ABCD has its centre on the diameter AF at the height of M, not at E, and the circle GBFD has its centre at E; the two circles meet at B and D. They are drawn so.
body L11: the letter of the reference (a) is bold italic; with chapter 31 the letters of the references begin again at a.
body L29: the words from «planeta» to «centrum H,» and the word «et» are italic (note 5).

body: some words are printed with heavier ink than their neighbours (among them «K» on L15, «MLR,» on L24 and «Punctum» on L27); they are in the roman type of the text. In «planetae» on L25 the first e is printed filled, so that it looks like an o.

body L4: Nallino's addenda et emendanda in Part II (p. XX; AB01-PDF0437-body-L025) read «est ipsa quantitas [sinus] mediae aequationis planetae»: the word sinus is wrongly left out in the codex (Part III, p. 95, line 16, «يكون بقدر تعديله الاوسط») and by Plato («est ut eius aequalis aequatio»). The printed «est ipsa quantitas mediae aequationis planetae» is kept.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
